opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search one-way or multi-city flights on Booking.com for given origin and destination airports and dates, then sort by Fastest, open a flight, and continue through the ticket-type step.
steps: Open booking.com and click the Flights tab.
Select One way (or Multi-city/Round trip) and set Direct flights only if needed.
Click the origin field, type the origin city or airport code, and tick the matching airport.
Click the destination field, type the destination, and tick the matching airport.
For multi-city, click Add a flight and repeat origin, destination and date for each leg.
Click the departure date field and pick the date.
Set adult count via the passengers control and click Done.
Click Search.
Click the Fastest sort tab, optionally tick a stop/airline filter.
Click See flight on the wanted itinerary, then click Select in the fare dialog.
Click Next on the ticket-type page (choose Standard or Flexible).
parameters: trip type (one way / round trip / multi-city)

instances.values: One way, Columbus (CMH) to Bangalore (BLR), direct flights only, 1 adult; stopped at the origin/destination filling step.
One way, Bangalore (BLR) to Goa/Panaji (GOI), 29 Mar 2023, 2 adults, direct only; sorted Fastest, selected SpiceJet/IndiGo fare, Next on ticket type.
Multi-city New York (NYC) to Tokyo (TYO), then Tokyo to Delhi (DEL), 1 adult, dates 1 Jun and 5 Jun 2023; sorted Fastest, See flight, Select, Next on ticket type.

opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search by pick-up location, dates and times
opportunities.description: Search Expedia rental cars for a pick-up airport or city with given dates and times, then optionally filter the results list by car class.
steps: Open expedia.com and click the Cars tab.
Click the Pick-up field, type the airport code or city, and choose the matching suggestion.
Set Same as pick-up for drop-off, or pick a different drop-off location.
Click the Pick-up date field, choose the start date in the calendar, then the end date, and click Done.
Open the Pick-up time dropdown and choose the time; do the same for Drop-off time.
Click Search.
On results, tick filters such as passenger count or Luxury class.

instances.values: Pick-up JFK (New York), Apr 5 to Apr 6, 10:30 am both times; search started and drop-off location step reached.
Pick-up and drop-off JFK, Apr 3 to Apr 6, pick-up 9:00 am, drop-off 6:00 pm; Search, then filter 2-5 passengers and Luxury on results.
Pick-up San Francisco, Apr 2 to Apr 3 changed to Apr 8 to Apr 9, 10:30 am; Search, then Avis filter on results.

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route and date
opportunities.description: Look up planned subway service changes on the MTA site for a given route number and date.
steps: Open the MTA site and open the menu, then click Planned Service Changes (or Planned Work in the top nav).
Click the Search Routes field and type the route or line code, then pick the match.
Click Select routes and confirm the route is selected.
Click the Select Date field and choose the target date in the calendar (use the arrows to change month).
Read the Results for section.

instances.values: Route S92, date 04/07/2023; typed the route into the search field.
Route 4, date 04/12/2023 moved forward to May 3, 2023; results showed no planned changes.

opportunities.name: Cruise sailing search by destination, departure port, month and guests
opportunities.description: Search cruises on a cruise site by destination region, sail-from port, travel month and number of guests, then read the results.
opportunities.site: cruise promo site (Royal Caribbean-style 'Shaq' page) and carnival.com
steps: Click the Sail To dropdown and choose the destination region or port (e.g. Panama Canal, Caribbean).
Click the Sail From dropdown and choose the departure port (e.g. San Francisco, CA).
Click the Dates dropdown, pick the year and month (e.g. Oct 2024).
Click Search Cruises.
On Carnival, click Number of Guests, set the count with +/- and close the panel to refilter.

instances.values: Sail To Panama Canal, Sail From San Francisco, CA.
Sail To Panama Canal, Sail From San Francisco, CA, Dates Oct 2024; search results.
Carnival results: Number of Guests changed from 2 to 3 to 4 on Western Caribbean cruises.

opportunities.name: E-commerce category listing: filter and sort by price low to high
opportunities.description: On a retailer's category page, drill into a category, apply product filters, sort by price low to high, and open a product.
steps: Open the site's Shop by Category / category menu and navigate to the gender or category (e.g. Women, Golf).
Tick the category filter (e.g. Clothing) and open the Product Type filter.
Tick the product type (e.g. Polos) and a size (e.g. M).
Click the Sort dropdown and choose Price (Low - High).
Click the first matching product to open it.

instances.values: Kohl's: Women menu, Women's Sweaters, Sort Featured to Price Low-High, opened a Sonoma sweater.
Under Armour: Women > Golf, Clothing checked, Product Type expanded.
Under Armour: Polos checked, size M, Sort Now Trending to Price (Low - High).

opportunities.name: Delta SkyMiles deals search by origin and destination
opportunities.description: On Delta's SkyMiles Deals page, set origin and destination airports and optionally a destination region, then read the deal table.
steps: Open delta.com SkyMiles Deals page.
Click the Origin field, type the airport code or city, and select it.
Click the Destination field and select the destination airport.
Optionally open Select Region Type and choose the region.
Click the arrow button to load deal results.

instances.values: Origin Columbus, OH (CMH), destination field then viewed.
Origin Philadelphia (PHL), destination Atlanta (ATL), region Domestic & North America.
